detail: Generic WebGPU f32 matmul (512^3, 3 MiB/dispatch) port of the microbench.mjs pattern: 4 variants (orig 8x8, wg256 16x16 control, ksplit2/ksplit4 K-split depths), timestamp-query per-dispatch timing, forward+reverse pooled (96 cold + 12 hot per variant), JS CPU reference per variant (0 mismatches, max|err| 1.2-3.4e-5), bytes/us roofline + K-search ranking. Best split by cold median: ksplit4 (1151.8 us, 2.7 GB/s). Real local GPU run on Apple M2 Max metal-3, Chrome 146; no model needed.

evidence.variance_note_R5: p90-p10 width >25% on all variants (e.g. orig p10 1344 / p90 4975 us); disclosed in record cold/hot stats + per-position order medians, committed as seen with a single run (ranking ksplit4 < wg256 < ksplit2 < orig holds in both forward and reverse positions)
